description: This file defines an interface (ILocalStore) for a local storage system, including methods for opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding entries. It also defines a shared pointer type for the interface.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: Interface for local storage operations, including opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving and removing entries, and adding entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the local storage at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the local storage.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table, starting from a specific index up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting at a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.
